title: Evaluation of point-of-use drinking water treatment performance for typical per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances in tap water
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, 11,2240-2247
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00210A, Paper
Yangyuan Ji, Tao Yuan, Zhenjin li, Yanan Xing, Yan Cao, Xiaoli Zhao, Xinyue Ma, Zhemin Shen, Shuangqing Hu, Genxiang Shen
PFASs have been detected in tap water, primarily PFOA, PFBS, PFHxA, and PFBA. The limitations of PFASs and population health risks from point-of-use drinking water treatment options were evaluated.
